about_the_game:
Chubu Centrair International Airport, (IATA: NGO, ICAO: RJGG), is located on the Artificial island of Ise Bay, Tokoname, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It is 3.5 kilometers away from the downtown of Tokoname and 37 kilometers away from the downtown of Nagoya. It is a 4E international airport, Japan's national central airport, and a portal aviation hub.

As of July 2020, Chubu Centrair International Airport has 2 terminals and 36 boarding bridges; There are a total of 81 aircraft stands on the civil aviation apron, including 28 near the bridge; There is one runway, 3500 meters long and 60 meters wide.

Features:

  • Custom Taxiway and runway texture

  • Terminal and surrounding buildings restored based on reality

  • Simple interior structure of the terminal building and tower

  • Custom airport ground service models

  • FPS is extremely friendly

  • Accurate taxiway according to the latest chart
